title: Perseverance
definition: Perseverance is the Spirit-enabled endurance of believers as they continue in faith, obedience, and hope through trials and opposition.
summary: Perseverance is continuing to trust and follow Christ through difficulty.
christFocus: Jesus preserves His people and strengthens them to endure until the end.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Perseverance is not stubborn self-reliance. It is endurance rooted in God's grace, sustained by the Spirit, and strengthened through the promises of God.

Believers face trials, temptation, opposition, weakness, grief, and weariness. Scripture does not pretend the path is easy, but it calls God's people to keep trusting Christ.

Perseverance is possible because God is faithful. The believer endures by looking to Jesus, receiving help from the body of Christ, clinging to Scripture, and trusting that suffering is not wasted.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people interpret hardship as proof that God has abandoned them. Perseverance matters because it teaches believers how to keep going when obedience is costly and faith feels weak.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Fix your eyes on Christ when you are weary. Stay connected to Scripture, prayer, and fellowship. Take the next obedient step even when you cannot see the whole path.
